name: Surprise_2
short_caption: The robot places its left hand on its chest and tilts its head slightly back in mild surprise or self-referential shock.
movement_description: The robot begins in a neutral standing posture. It raises its left hand to its upper chest, splaying its fingers slightly, while its head tilts backward and slightly to the right in a classic startled gesture. After a brief pause in this pose, the robot lowers its left arm back to its side and returns its head to the upright, forward-facing neutral position.
safety_notes: The left arm raises to chest level but stays close to the body, posing minimal risk to the immediate surrounding space.
